speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade) (Mr Lim Hng Kiang)
text: and The Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry) (Mr S Iswaran): MTI aims to achieve sustainable economic growth so as to create good jobs for Singaporeans.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade) (Mr Lim Hng Kiang)
text: In the Advanced Manufacturing cluster, existing capabilities will be enhanced to expand into new types of high-value manufacturing.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade) (Mr Lim Hng Kiang)
text: Our investments in technology, like 3D printing and robotics, will help grow competitive niche segments.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade) (Mr Lim Hng Kiang)
text: We will also develop industries around Smart and Sustainable Urban Solutions.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade) (Mr Lim Hng Kiang)
text: As cities urbanise in Asia, there are many opportunities to commercialise innovative urban solutions developed in Singapore, which can be scaled and exported overseas.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade) (Mr Lim Hng Kiang)
text: The Logistics and Aerospace industries will support growing trade within and out of Asia.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade) (Mr Lim Hng Kiang)
text: Deepening specialised logistics capabilities will help keep Singapore well-connected and maintain our position as one of the leading air and sea ports in Asia.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade) (Mr Lim Hng Kiang)
text: The biomedical sciences cluster, which comprises global market leaders in medical technology and pharmaceuticals, is vital for Singapore to tap on emerging opportunities in Applied Health Sciences.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade) (Mr Lim Hng Kiang)
text: MTI will support companies in this sector to meet the needs of a rapidly ageing population in Asia, as well as to target emerging segments, for instance, in geriatrics and preventive care.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade) (Mr Lim Hng Kiang)
text: To sustain these growth clusters, industrial and energy infrastructure will be enhanced, along with Singapore's status as a vibrant global city.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade) (Mr Lim Hng Kiang)
text: This will ensure that Singapore remains attractive to investors, companies, talent and visitors.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade) (Mr Lim Hng Kiang)
text: Investment in R&D is a key enabler in our plans to develop the identified growth clusters.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade) (Mr Lim Hng Kiang)
text: This will involve promoting collaboration between companies, research institutes and startups and also enhancing access to technology for small local companies.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade) (Mr Lim Hng Kiang)
text: For startups, we will continue to foster an attractive environment for entrepreneurial talent to thrive in Singapore and facilitate their expansion overseas.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade) (Mr Lim Hng Kiang)
text: We will deepen our partnership with Trade Associations and Chambers (TACs) to support SMEs to restructure and raise productivity.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade) (Mr Lim Hng Kiang)
text: Beyond developing a strong business ecosystem in Singapore, expanding market access overseas will create opportunities for our companies and for Singaporeans.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade) (Mr Lim Hng Kiang)
text: Singaporeans will need deep skills to access good jobs and remain relevant as technology changes the nature of work.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade) (Mr Lim Hng Kiang)
text: To equip Singaporeans at all career stages for jobs of the future, MTI will partner MOM, MOE, industry players and unions in SkillsFuture initiatives.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade) (Mr Lim Hng Kiang)
text: Employers are also a vital part of the SkillsFuture journey.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade) (Mr Lim Hng Kiang)
text: MTI will continue to support the development of sectoral manpower plans to support industry growth and productivity efforts in key sectors.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade) (Mr Lim Hng Kiang)
text: SkillsFuture Mentors will also help guide SMEs as they upgrade their training and development capabilities.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade) (Mr Lim Hng Kiang)
text: Our efforts to prepare Singaporeans for the future represent a commitment to bring both our economy and our people forward together into a better future.
